description: Validation of the second APOBEC4 metal site across ortholog models, against a within-protein null, and by PAE
code:
"""
Final validation figure for the second metal site. All values come from
table11_site2_ortholog_models.csv and table12_circumsphere_null.csv, both computed
in this session; the PAE values are from the AlphaFold API for Q8WW27.
"""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT='/agent/jobs/5a541e70-d6f7-48b5-be7a-399123e44147/provenance'
orth=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/table11_site2_ortholog_models.csv")
orth['short']=orth.organism.str.split().str[:2].str.join(' ')

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.4))

a=ax[0]
o=orth.sort_values('mean_d')
a.barh(o.short,o.mean_d,color='#2e7d32')
a.axvspan(2.0,2.5,color='#ffe082',alpha=.7,zorder=0)
a.set_xlim(0,3.2); a.set_xlabel("circumsphere radius of the 4 donors (A)")
a.set_title("A. Nine independently predicted ortholog models\nreproduce the site (2.40 +/- 0.15 A)",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.tick_params(labelsize=8)
for i,(v,p) in enumerate(zip(o.mean_d,o.pLDDT)): a.text(v+0.05,i,f"pLDDT {p:.0f}",va='center',fontsize=7)

a=ax[1]
q=['CYS28/CYS31\nHIS34/CYS87','HIS93/CYS127\nHIS132/CYS134','HIS65/HIS93\nCYS127/CYS134']
v=[2.41,3.02,3.53]
a.bar(q,v,color=['#2e7d32','#90a4ae','#90a4ae'])
a.axhspan(2.0,2.5,color='#ffe082',alpha=.7,zorder=0)
a.axhline(4.18,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); a.text(0.0,4.3,"median of all 11 quadruples",fontsize=8)
a.set_ylabel("circumsphere radius (A)"); a.set_ylim(0,5)
a.set_title("B. Of 11 Cys/His quadruples in APOBEC4,\nonly one is metal-compatible",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=7)

a=ax[2]
lab=['catalytic\n91-97 vs 125-136','site 2\n26-36 vs 85-89','site 2 vs catalytic\n26-36 vs 91-97',
     'whole protein\nmean','disordered C-term\n330-367 vs 26-36']
pv=[2.08,5.00,6.25,17.80,30.91]
a.bar(lab,pv,color=['#1565c0','#2e7d32','#90a4ae','#757575','#c62828'])
a.set_ylabel("mean predicted aligned error (A)")
a.set_title("C. PAE: the site-2 donors are confidently\nplaced relative to each other",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=7)

fig.suptitle("APOBEC4 Cys28/Cys31/His34/Cys87: a second metal site that survives three independent controls",fontsize=12)
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.93])
plt.show()
